on Monday started a private offering of $2B of first-lien notes due 2031 and also launched syndication of a new $850M first-lien term loan.
The company also secured a commitment for a $1.12B second-lien term loan from Deutsche Bank
AG NY Branch, bringing the planned financing to $3.97B.
The proceeds, along with cash on hand, will be used to tender for AMC’s 7.5% senior secured notes due 2029 and redeem any remaining notes around February 15, 2027.
The part of proceeds will also be used to fully repay Muvico’s $903.4M senior secured notes, AMC’s existing term loan, and Odeon Finco PLC’s existing term loan, along with related fees and expenses.
The new debt is intended to restructure and refinance AMC’s existing debt, with completion dependent on market conditions and other customary conditions.
On the market side, the AMC stock traded 1.85% higher at ~$2.75 in the pre-market hours.

title: AMC Entertainment starts $3.97B debt plan to refinance notes, term loans
